title: Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
abstract: arXiv:2611.34935v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. Across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks. Two unified models, BAGEL and Janus-Pro-7B, each lose accuracy on eight tasks. On VSTAR, adding a generated image to the same planning hint lowers accuracy by 10.47 points. Repeated image edits yield different outcomes across tasks. ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines, while ERQA gains three points after ten edits.

translated_title: 图像生成能否帮助视觉推理？一项实证研究
translated_abstract: 语言模型用词语思考，那么多模态模型是否可能用图像思考？我们测试了生成辅助图像能否改善视觉问答的表现。模型首先描述它所需要的辅助图像，然后结合原始图像和生成图像一起回答问题。在13组视觉语言模型与生成器的配对实验中，图像生成使平均准确率下降了3.7个百分点，十个任务中有九个出现下降。两个统一模型BAGEL和Janus-Pro-7B各自在八个任务上损失了准确率。在VSTAR数据集上，在相同的规划提示下额外加入一张生成图像会使准确率降低10.47个百分点。重复的图像编辑在不同任务上产生了不同结果：ChartQAPro和MathVista始终低于无生成基线，而ERQA在十次编辑后提升了三个百分点。
tldr: 这项实证研究发现，通过生成辅助图像来帮助视觉推理在大多数情况下反而会降低性能——在13组视觉语言模型与生成器的配对实验中平均准确率下降3.7个百分点，十个任务中九个出现下降——挑战了“多模态模型可以用图像思考”的假设。
en_tdlr: This empirical study finds that generated helper images generally hurt visual reasoning—across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, mean accuracy drops by 3.7 percentage points with declines on nine of ten tasks—challenging the assumption that multimodal models can "think in images."
